lead_headline: Weekend restaurant activity stalled — just 3 new leads (2 openings, 1 closure) marks slowest Friday-Sunday detection since tracking launch.

restaurant.blurb: 3 leads since Friday — Wapos Cantina in Rosedale and Mendocino Farms at Union Station opened, while Powered By Besitos food truck in West Colfax closed.

foreclosure.blurb: One $15 million filing in Weld County — listed at FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY address, scheduled for July 31 auction.

liquor.blurb: Weekend remains frozen — zero applications filed across all categories extends drought to 11 consecutive business days since July 21. Weekly count holds at zero for third straight week, down from 8 applications in comparable mid-July period. State processing system shows no batch activity through Friday close, suggesting administrative gap now exceeds typical monthly cycle. If silence persists through Monday, drought will mark longest application freeze in tracking history.

reputation.blurb: 21 mentions since Friday across 8 sources — down 73% from prior week's 77. Instagram led with 6 citations, Facebook added 5, Denver Post contributed 4. Building Salt Lake covered Alterra ski HQ relocation story, Post reported Fire on the Mountain Central Park opening. Week's 3.0 mentions/day average marks second-lowest sustained rate of 2026. Weekend collapse extends three-week decline from spring peak — if August maintains current pace, monthly total will finish well below Q2 baseline.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +6 since Friday (7 new, 1 canceled) pushes MTD to +0 (+0.0/day), 90-day net holds at +100. Weekend delivered consistent positive momentum — Friday posted +6 net, Saturday and Sunday both flat. Full seven-day window shows strong recovery: +19 net (27 new, 8 canceled) reverses prior week's −8 and marks best weekly performance since late July. Recent two-week pattern confirms volatility stabilizing after mid-July turbulence (−14 single-day drop on 7/21 followed by +11 rebound on 7/23). If August maintains even modest weekly gains, month could restore annual trajectory and erase July's −16 finish. YTD unchanged at +216 (+1.0/day).
